senses.gloss:
परि परि (an indeclinable particle and
prefix to verbs and their derivative nouns; often
परी in composition; allied to पर, परा, प्र),
round, around, about, round about; further, in
addition to; against, opposite to, in the way; much,
excessively.
(As a separable preposition, especially in the Veda),
around, about (with acc., e. g. मध्यन्-दिनम् परि,
about midday); against, opposite to, towards, to (with
acc., e. g. वृक्षम् परि, in the direction of a
tree; त्वा परि, against thee); to the share of (with
acc., e. g. यन् माम् परि स्यात्, what may fall to
my lot); beyond, more than (with acc., e. g. दै-
वीम् परि वाक्, a voice more than divine); after,
successively, severally (with acc. distributively, e. g.
वृक्षं वृक्षम् परि सिञ्चति, he waters tree
after tree); from, away from, out of (with abl. after
verbs of motion, e. g. समुद्राद् उत वा दिवः
परि, out of sea or sky); outside of, except, with
exception of (with abl., e. g. परि त्रिगर्तेभ्यः,
round about or outside Tri-garta); after the lapse
or expiration of (with abl., e. g. परि संवत्सरात्,
after the lapse of a full year); in consequence of,
on account of, for the sake of (with abl., e. g.
रक्षसः परि, on account of the Rakṣas);
according to, in accordance with (with abl., e. g.
धर्मणः परि, according to the ordinance);
above, over (Ved. according to the Scholiast = अधि,
उपरि).
[]
(As an adverbial prefix to nouns not immediately
connected with verbs), very, excessively (e. g. पर्य्-
अश्रु, very tearful; परि-दुर्बल, excessively weak).
At the beginning of an adverbial comp. परि
implies outside, without, except, exclusive of (e. g.
परि-त्रिगर्तम्, outside Trigarta, Pāṇ. II. 1. 12,
VI. 2, 33; and according to Pāṇ. II. 1, 10, it may
be used in this sense at the end of an adverbial
comp., but only after अक्ष, शलाका, and a numeral).
At the beginning of an adjective comp., according
to Pāṇ. (II. 2, 18, Vārt. 7), परि may be used in
the sense of परि-ग्लान, exhausted, (but पर्य्-
अध्ययन is said to mean ‘one to whom study is
repugnant.’) Native lexicographers explain the senses
of परि by the following Sanskrit words: आ-लिङ्गन,
दोषाख्यान (दोष-कीर्तन), निर्-असन (नि-
वसन), पूजा, भूषण, व्याधि, व्य्-आप्ति, उप-
रम, शोक, शेष, अति-शय, त्याग, नि-यम;
[cf. Zend pairi; Gr. περί, πέριξ, περι-σσό-ς, -περ;
Lat. per- in adj., e. g. per-idoneus: probably Old
Germ. furi; Old Iceland. fyri; Mod. Germ. für;
Hib. faoi, ‘about, round.’]

परी परी (परि-इ, see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2. P.
पर्य्-एति, -एतुम्, to go about, move in a circle, go
or flow round, walk round, circumambulate, roam
about; to encompass, encircle, include, grasp, span;
to run against; to reach, attain to; (with or without
मनसा) to perceive, ponder: Intens., Ved. परीयते,
to revolve round, move round, move in a circle.

पारी पारी, f. (fr. rt. पॄ), a cup, drinking-
vessel, &c. See पार, p. 566, col. 2.

परिकथा परि-कथा, f. a work of fiction,
tale, story, the history or adventures of any fabulous
person.

परिकम्प परि-कम्प, अस्, m. trembling
violently, great fear or terror.
परि-कम्पिन्, ई, इनी, इ, trembling violently.

परिकर परि-कर, परि-कर्मन्. See under
परि-कृ below.

परि-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, who or what helps or
assists, a helper; (अस्), m. attendants, dependants,
retinue, train, followers (in these senses also आस्, m.
pl.); a multitude, crowd; preparation (परिकरम्
बन्ध् or कृ, to make preparations); beginning,
commencement, effort; a girdle for confining a
loose garment, a girth, zone, sash, a cloth worn
round the loins; (in dramatic language) covert or
indirect intimation of coming events in the plot of
a drama, the germ of the Vīja; (in rhetoric) a par-
ticular figure, the employment of allusive epithets;
discrimination, judgment.
परिकर्तन परि-कर्तन. See 1. परि-कृत्.

परि-कर्तन, अस्, आ, अम्, cutting up, cutting to
pieces; (अम्), n. cutting, cutting off or round, a cir-
cular incision; cutting out, shelling; a shooting pain.
परिकर्ष परि-कर्ष. See 1. परि-कृष्.

परि-कर्ष, अस्, m. or परि-कर्षण, अम्, n.
dragging about.

परिकल् 1. परि-कल् (see rt. 2. कल्), cl. 10.
P. -कालयति, &c., to drive about, chase, persecute.

परिकल् 2. परि-कल् (see rt. 3. कल्), cl. 10.
P. -कलयति, &c., to see, observe; to consider as,
regard as.

परिकल्कन परि-कल्कन, अम्, n. deceit,
cheating; [cf. कल्कन.]

परिकाङ्क्षित परि-काङ्क्षित, अस्, m. a de-
votee, a religious ascetic.

परिकायन परिकायन (?), आस्, m. pl., N.
of a school.
परिकीर्ण परि-कीर्ण. See परि-कॄ, col. 3.

परि-कीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, spread, diffused, scattered
around or about; surrounded, crowded about.
परिकीर्तन परि-कीर्तन. See परि-कॄत्.

परि-कीर्तन, अम्, n. proclaiming aloud, pro-
claiming, stating, saying, telling, talking of; boast-
ing; naming.

परिकुप् परि-कुप्, cl. 4. P. A. -कुप्यति,
-ते, &c., to become greatly moved or excited, to
suffer violent emotion, to be in a rage, be very
angry: Caus. -कोपयति, -यितुम्, to excite violently;
to make very angry.
परि-कोप, अस्, m. great or violent anger.

परिकूट परि-कूट, अम्, n. a barrier, a
trench before the gate of a town forming a sort of
covered way; (अस्), m., N. of a Nāga-rāja.

पारिकुट पारिकुट, अस्, m., Ved. an at-
tendant, servant.

परिकृ परि-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-
रुते, -कर्तुम्, to surround; [cf. परि-ष्-कृ.]

परिकॄ परि-कॄ, cl. 6. P. -किरति, -करितुम्,
-करीतुम्, to scatter or strew about, scatter round,
besprinkle; to surround; to deliver over.

परि-कर्तृ, ता, m. a priest who performs the
marriage ceremony for a younger brother whose
elder brother is not yet married.

परि-कर्मन्, आ, m. a servant, an assistant, a
[]
slave; (अ), n. the act of surrounding or attending on
(any one), worship, adoration; personal decoration,
dressing, painting, or perfuming the body; perfum-
ing the person after bathing; cleansing, purifying;
a means of purification; preparation; arithmetical
computation or operation.
—परिकर्माष्टक
(˚म-अष्˚), अम्, n. the eight fundamental rules of
arithmetic, viz. addition, subtraction, multiplication,
division, finding the square, extracting the square root,
finding the cube and extracting the cube root.

परि-कर्मय, Nom. P. परिकर्मयति, &c.,
to anoint, decorate, adorn.

परि-कर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, adorning, decorating,
&c.; (ई, इणी), m. f. an assistant, a servant, slave.

परि-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, (Mahā-bh.
Anuśāsana-p. 5044.)

परि-क्रिया, f. surrounding, inclosing, inclosing
with a fence or ditch, intrenching; attending to (a
sacred fire &c.), attention; (in dramatic language)
allusion to future action, = परि-कर.
परिक्रिया परि-क्रिया, f. See परि-कृ, p. 538.

परिकृत् 1. परि-कृत्, cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति,
-कर्तितुम्, to cut round, clip, cut off; to exclude
from.

परिकृत् 2. परि-कृत्, cl. 7. P. -कृणत्ति,
-कर्तितुम्, to wind round.

परिकॄत् परि-कॄत्, cl. 10. P. -कीर्तयति,
-यितुम्, to proclaim on all sides, announce, relate,
communicate; to celebrate, praise, glorify; to pro-
pound; to declare, pronounce; to account; to call,
name: Pass. -कीर्त्यते, to be called.

परि-कर्तिका, f. sharp shooting pain, especially in
the rectum.

परिकृश परि-कृश, अस्, आ, अम्, very thin,
emaciate, wasted.

परिकृष् 1. परि-कृष्, cl. 1. P. -कर्षति,
-कर्ष्टुम्, -क्रष्टुम्, to draw or drag about,
to carry about with one; to lead (an army); to
ponder, reflect constantly upon; cl. 6. P. A. -कृषति,
-ते, (Ved.) to draw or make furrows, to plough:
Caus. -कर्षयति, -यितुम्, to drag to and fro, tor-
ment, harass, vex, trouble.

परि-कर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, dragged about; ha-
rassed, tortured (e. g. काम-प्˚, tortured with love).

परि-कर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, dragging away, carrying
off, carrying about (to every place).
परि-कृष्ट, अस्, m., N. of a teacher.

परि-कीर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, proclaimed, promul-
gated, announced; vaunted, boasted of; said, de-
clared, called.

परिकॢप् परि-कॢप्, cl. 1. A. -कल्पते, -कल्-
पितुम्, -कल्प्तुम् (the simple verb appears only to
occur in the part.): Caus. -कल्पयति, -यितुम्, to
fix, settle, decide, determine; to destine for; to per-
form, execute, effect, accomplish, make, form, invent;
to contrive, arrange; to distribute; to invite.

परि-कल्पन, अम्, n. deciding, fixing, settling,
agreeing upon; making, inventing, forming, con-
triving, performing; furnishing, providing, dividing,
distributing; (आ), f. making, forming, assuming a
form or shape; contrivance; reckoning.

परि-कल्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, settled, decided, agreed
upon; made, invented; contrived, arranged; distri-
buted, divided; provided with, furnished with.

परि-कल्प्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be settled, to be
calculated.

परि-कॢप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, existing or occurring
here and there, distributed.

परिक्रन्द् परि-क्रन्द्, Caus. P. -क्रन्दयति,
-यितुम्, Ved. to cry or make a noise round about.

परिक्रम् परि-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. -क्रामति, -क्र-
मितुम्, -क्रान्तुम्, to step or walk round or about,
circumambulate, go round, roam about for pleasure,
roam over, walk through, visit (with acc.); to out-
strip, overtake: Intens. -चङ्क्रमीति, to move or
walk about continually, turn round perpetually.

परि-क्रम, अस्, m. walking round or about,
walking for pleasure, circumambulating, going about,
going over, passing over, roaming, walking, going;
pervading, penetrating; succession; series, order.
—परिक्रम-सह, अस्, m. ‘one who bears running
about,’ a goat.

परि-क्रमण, अम्, n., Ved. walking about,
going or roaming about.

परि-क्रमत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, moving or wander-
ing about.

परि-क्रामत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going or moving
round or about.
परि-क्रम्य, ind. having walked round or about.

परि-क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, walked round, stepped
upon; (अम्), n. the place or spot on which any one
has walked about or stepped, foot-steps, foot-prints,
traces.

परि-क्रान्ति, इस्, f. moving round, revolution,
circumrotation.

परि-क्रामम्, ind., Ved. going about, [cf. अ-प-
रिक्रामम्.]

परिक्री 1. परि-क्री, cl. 9. P. -क्रीणाति, -क्रे-
तुम्, to purchase, buy, give in exchange, ac-
quire, gain (with inst. or dat. of the price, e. g.
शतेन or शताय परि-क्री, to buy for a hundred);
to hire, engage for hire or for stipulated wages; A.
-क्रीणीते, -क्रेतुम्, to recompense, reward.
2. परि-क्री, Ved., N. of the second Sādyaskra.

परि-क्रय, अस्, m. hire, wages; redemption,
purchasing or purchasing back, buying off; a parti-
cular kind of treaty, a peace purchased with money.
परि-क्रयण, अम्, n. engaging for hire, hiring.
परि-क्रीणान, अस्, आ, अम्, purchasing, buying.
परि-क्रीत, अस्, आ, अम्, purchased, bought; hired.

परिक्रीड् परि-क्रीड्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रीडति,
-ते, -क्रीडितुम्, to play about.

परिक्रुध् परि-क्रुध्, cl. 4. P. -क्रुध्यति,
-क्रोद्धुम्, to fly into a rage or passion, to become
enraged.

परिक्रुश् परि-क्रुश्, cl. 1. P. -क्रोशति,
-क्रोष्टुम्, to go about crying, to wail, lament.

परिक्लम् परि-क्लम्, cl. 4. P. -क्लाम्यति,
-क्लमितुम्, to be tired out or exhausted.

परि-क्लान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, very tired, tired out,
exhausted.

परिक्लिद् परि-क्लिद्, cl. 4. P. -क्लिद्यति, -क्ले-
दितुम्, -क्लेत्तुम्, to be very wet or damp.

परि-क्लिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, very wet, excessively
moist or humid.
परि-क्लेद, अस्, m. humidity, wetness, dampness.
परि-क्लेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wetting, moistening; wet.

परिक्लिश् परि-क्लिश्, cl. 9. P. -क्लिश्नाति, -क्ले-
शितुम्, -क्लेष्टुम्, to pain, torment, harass, vex;
cl. 4. P. A. -क्लिश्यति, -ते, to suffer, feel pain; to be
vexed or troubled or harassed.
परि-क्लिश, अस्, m. (?), vexation, trouble.

परि-क्लिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, much vexed or annoyed,
sorely troubled, pained, harassed, exhausted, fatigued;
(अम्), n. pain, suffering, vexation; (अम्), ind. with
a feeling of uneasiness or reluctance, unwillingly.
परि-क्लेश, अस्, m. hardship, fatigue.

परि-क्लेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, causing pain or trouble,
a tormentor, torturer.

परिक्वणन परि-क्वणन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt.
क्वण् with परि), loud-sounding, loud.

परिक्षन् परि-क्षन् or परि-क्षण्, cl. 8. P.
A. -क्षणोति, -क्षणुते, -क्षणितुम्, to wound,
hurt, injure.

परि-क्षत, अस्, आ, अम्, wounded, hurt, injured,
abraded, cut, scratched; killed.
परि-क्षति, इस्, f. wounding, injury, lesion.
परिक्षय परि-क्षय. See परि-क्षि below.

परि-क्षय, अस्, m. disappearing, ceasing, failure,
ruin; dissolution, decay, waste, destruction.

परिक्षर् परि-क्षर्, cl. 1. P. -क्षरति,
-क्षरितुम्, to stream or flow round, flow or stream
towards.

परिक्षल् परि-क्षल्, cl. 10. P. -क्षालयति,
-यितुम्, to wash out, rinse, wash off.
परि-क्षालन, अम्, n. water for washing.

परिक्षव परि-क्षव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. क्षु
with परि), Ved. (ill-omened) sneezing.

परिक्षा परि-क्षा, f. (fr. rt. क्षै with
परि?), clay, mud, dirt.

परीक्षा, f. investigation, examination, test, trial,
experiment, discrimination; trial by ordeal of various
kinds; N. of a commentary on Piṅgala's Chandaḥ-
śāstra.

परि-क्षाण, अम्, n., Ved. that which is charred
or burnt to a cinder.

परीक्षण, अम्, n. trying, testing, experiment,
examination, putting to the test, trying, proving.

परिक्षाम परि-क्षाम, अस्, आ, अम् (said to
be fr. rt. क्षै with परि), excessively emaciated or
wasted away, dried up, fallen away.

परिक्षि परि-क्षि (see rt. 4. क्षि), cl. 5. 9.
P. -क्षिणोति, -क्षिणाति, -क्षेतुम्, to destroy, put an
end to: Pass. -क्षीयते, to waste away, decay, become
exhausted; to be brought low; to become poor.

परि-क्षीण, अस्, आ, अम्, vanished, disappeared;
quite decayed, wasted, emaciated, worn away; ex-
hausted; brought low; entirely ruined; diminished,
decreased; lost, destroyed; (in law) insolvent.

परिक्षित् परि-क्षित् or परी-क्षित् (see rt. 2.
क्षि), Ved. spreading round or about, extending;
(‘living about or among mankind’), an epithet of
Agni; (औ), du. an epithet of heaven and earth; (त्),
m., N. of an ancient king, a son of Abhi-manyu and
father of Janam-ejaya; of a son of Kuru and father
of another Janam-ejaya; of a son of A-vikṣit and
brother of Janam-ejaya; of a king of A-yodhyā.

परीक्षित् परी-क्षित्, त्, m. (connected with
and frequently written परि-क्षित्), N. of a son of
Abhi-manyu and father of Janam-ejaya; of a son of
Kuru; of a son of An-aśvan and father of Bhīma-
sena; of a king of A-yodhyā.

पारीक्षित् पारीक्षित्, त्, m. = पारीक्षित, a
patronymic of Janam-ejaya.

परिक्षिप् परि-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -क्षिपति,
-ते, -क्षेप्तुम्, to throw over or beyond; to put
or lay or wind round; to throw about, surround,
encircle, embrace; to overlay; to fetter; to throw
or put into.

परि-क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown about, scattered,
diffused; surrounded, encircled, intrenched; over-
spread, overlaid; struck; left, abandoned.

परि-क्षेप, अस्, m. throwing about, moving to
and fro; scattering, spreading, diffusion; surround-
ing, encircling, circumfluence; an encircling belt or
boundary, that by which anything is surrounded;
being surrounded; abandoning, leaving.

परि-क्षेपक, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what scatters
or disperses or surrounds.

परि-क्षेपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, who or what throws
about, scatters, or distributes, &c.

परिक्षीव परि-क्षीव, अस्, आ, अम्, drunk,
quite intoxicated.

परिखण्डय परि-खण्डय, Nom. P. -खण्-
डयति, -यितुम्, to make small, humiliate, conquer.

परिखन् परि-खन्, cl. 1. P. A. -खनति,
-ते, -खनितुम्, to dig round, dig up.

परि-खा, f. a moat, ditch, trench or fosse
round a town or fort; N. of a village in the North
country.
—परिखा-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, secure, im-
pregnable.

परि-खात, अस्, आ, अम्, dug round; (अस्), m. a
furrow, rut.

परिखिद् परि-खिद्, cl. 4. P. -खिद्यति,
-खेत्तुम्, to be depressed, to feel uneasy or dis-
turbed, to be afflicted: Caus. -खेदयति, -यितुम्,
to trouble, afflict, injure, destroy.

परि-खिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, depressed, afflicted,
exhausted.

परि-खेद, अस्, m. lassitude, fatigue, sleepiness,
exhaustion, being worn out.

परिख्या परि-ख्या, cl. 2. P. (in the non-
conjugational tenses also A.) -ख्याति, -ख्यातुम्,
to look round or about, look at, perceive (Ved.);
to observe, regard, consider; to overlook, disregard
(Ved.).

परि-ख्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, regarded as; called,
named; celebrated, famous.
परि-ख्याति, इस्, f. reputation, fame, celebrity.

परिगण परि-गण, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
a house.

वृध्, p. 548, col. 3), cut excavated.
2. परि-वर्धित, अस्, आ, अम्, increased, augmented.

परिवर्मन् परि-वर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, wearing a
coat of mail, clad in mail, armed.

परिवर्ह परि-वर्ह, परि-वर्हण. See
परि-बर्ह, परि-बर्हण, p. 545, col. 1.

परिवस् परि-वस् (see rt. 4. वस्), cl. 10. P.
-वासयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to split, cut through.
परि-वासन, अम्, n., Ved. a shred, chip.

परिवसथ परि-वसथ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 6.
वस् with परि), a village.

परि-वास, अस्, m. abode, residence, stay, sojourn;
[cf. काल-प्˚.]
2. परि-वास, अस्, m. fragrance, perfume.

परि-वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, respectfully attentive to
superiors (?).

परिवह् परि-वह्, cl. 1. P. A. -वहति, -ते,
-वोढुम्, to carry round, carry about.

परि-वह, अस्, m., N. of one of the seven winds;
one of the seven tongues of fire.

परि-वाह, अस्, m. the overflowing of a tank, an
inundation, overflow natural or artificial; a water-
course or drain to carry off excess of water; [cf.
परी-वाह.]
—परिवाह-वत्, आन्, m. ‘having a
channel,’ a tank, pool.

परीवाह परी-वाह, अस्, m. a drain, &c., see
परि-वाह; a scabbard (?).
परि-वाहित, अस्, आ, अम्, drained.

परि-वाहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, overflowing, swimming
with.
परि-वापण, अम्, n. shaving, shearing.
परि-वापित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaven, shorn.

परि-वाप्य or परी-वाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
having or requiring or deserving fried grains of rice
or thickened milk.

परिवार परि-वार, परि-वारण. See under
परि-वृ, col. 2.

परि-वार, अस्, m. (also spelt परी-वार), a cover,
covering; surroundings, train, suite, retinue, attend-
ants, dependants, subjects, followers; a sheath, scab-
bard.
—परिवार-ता, f. subjection, dependance.
—प-
रिवार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a great retinue.
—परिवार-शोभिन्, ई, इनी, इ, rendered illustrious
by a retinue.

परीवार परी-वार, अस्, m. retinue, depend-
ants, family, &c. See परि-वार.

परिवासस् परि-वासस्, अस्, n., Ved. (pro-
bably) an upper garment; अङ्गिरसाम् अभिवासः-
परिवाससी, N. of two Sāmans.

परिविंशत् परि-विंशत्, त्, f. quite twenty,
full twenty, twenty at least.

परिविक्रयिन् परि-विक्रयिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. rt.
1. क्री with परि-वि), selling or trading in (with gen.).

परिविक्षत परि-विक्षत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt.
क्षन् with परि-वि), sorely wounded, much hurt.

परिविक्षोभ परि-विक्षोभ, अस्, m. (fr. rt.
1. क्षुभ् with परि-वि), shaking violently, de-
stroying.

परिविचर् परि-वि-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति,
-चरितुम्, Ved. to stream forth in all directions.

परिविद् परि-विद्, cl. 2. P. -वेत्ति, -वेद,
-वेदितुम्, Ved. to know thoroughly, understand
fully; cl. 6. P. A. -विन्दति, -ते, -वेदितुम्, -वेत्तुम्,
to marry before an elder brother.

परि-विण्ण or परि-वित्त or परि-वित्ति, इस्, m.
an unmarried elder brother whose younger brother
is married.
—परिवित्ति-ता, f. the marrying of a
younger brother before the elder.

परि-विन्दक, अस्, m. a younger brother married
before the elder.
परि-विन्दत्, अन्, m. an unmarried elder brother.

परि-विविदान, अस्, m., Ved. a married man
whose elder brother is still unmarried.

परि-वेत्तृ, ता, m. or परि-वेदक, अस्, m. a
younger brother married before the elder.
परीवेत्तृ परी-वेत्तृ = परि-वेत्तृ, q. v.
परि-वेद, अस्, m. complete or accurate knowledge.

1. परि-वेदन, अम्, n. (for 2. see p. 549, col. 1),
complete or accurate knowledge; discussion; anguish,
pain, misery; the marrying of a younger brother
before the elder; marriage; laying the fire on the
sacrificial fire-place; gain, acquisition; (आ), f. shrewd-
ness, wit; foresight, prudence.

परिवेदन 2. परि-वेदन, अम्, n. (probably
a various reading for परि-देवन), complaining,
lamentation. (For 1. see p. 548, col. 1.)

परि-वेदनीया or परि-वेदिनी, f. the wife of a
younger brother who has married before the elder.
परि-वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, knowing, shrewd.

परिविद्ध परि-विद्ध, अस्, m. (perhaps fr.
परि-व्यध्), an epithet of Kuvera; [cf. पर-
विद्ध.]

परिविश् परि-विश् (often confounded with
परि-विष् below), Caus. -वेशयति, -यितुम्, to pro-
vide; to offer, present, (probably for परि-विष्, q. v.)

परिविष् परि-विष्, Caus. P. -वेषयति,
-यितुम्, to surround; to present, offer, offer food;
to wait on; (sometimes erroneously written परि-
विश्, q. v.)
परि-वेशस्, आस्, m., Ved. a neighbour.

परिविश्वस् परि-वि-श्वस्, cl. 2. P. -श्वसिति,
-श्वसितुम्, to confide completely, feel secure, be
fearless: Caus. -श्वासयति, -यितुम्, to comfort,
console.
परि-श्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, feeling secure, confident.

परि-विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, enclosed;
offered, presented.
परि-विष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. service, attendance.

परि-वेष, अस्, m. (sometimes wrongly spelt
परि-वेश), preparation (of food); attendance, wait-
ing at meals, distributing food, serving up meals; a
circle, circlet, wreath, crown; the circumference of
a circle; the disk of the sun or moon; a halo round
the sun or moon; anything surrounding or protecting
(e. g. कृताङ्गरक्षा-प्˚, surrounded by a body-
guard); putting on, clothing, dressing.
—परिवेष-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a halo, surrounded by a halo.
परिवेष परि-वेष. See p. 548, col. 2.
परीवेश परी-वेश = परि-वेष, q. v.

परि-वेषक, अस्, m. (sometimes wrongly परि-
वेशक), an attendant, waiter, one who serves up
meals.
परि-वेषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, surrounded by a halo.

परि-वेष्टव्य or परि-वेष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to
be served up; to be offered or presented.

परि-वेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, a waiter; one who
serves up meals.

परिविष्णु परि-विष्णु, ind. = सर्वतो विष्-
णुः.

परिविहार परि-विहार, अस्, m. walking or
roaming about, walking for pleasure.

परिविह्वल परि-विह्वल, अस्, आ, अम्, ex-
tremely agitated, bewildered, beside one's self.
—प-
रिविह्वल-ता, f. bewilderment.

परिवी परि-वी, परि-वीत. See under
परि-व्ये, p. 549, col. 1.
परि-वी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. wound round.

परिवृ परि-वृ, cl. 5. 9. 1. P. A. -वृणोति,
-णुते, -वृणाति, -णीते, -वरति, -ते, -वरितुम्, -व-
रीतुम्, to surround, conceal: Caus. -वारयति, -यि-
तुम्, to surround, cover, clothe.

परि-वारण, अम्, n. a cover, covering, envelope;
a train, retinue; keeping or warding off.

परि-वारित, अस्, आ, अम्, encompassed, surrounded,
encircled, enclosed, begirt.
परि-वार्य, ind. having surrounded or encompassed.

परि-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, encompassed, surrounded,
encircled, attended, invested; concealed; overspread,
pervaded; entirely gained or received; known;
(अम्), n., Ved. a covered place or shed enclosed
with walls used as a place of sacrifice.

परि-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, revolved, gone round;
turned back, retreated, retired, returned; exchanged,
bartered; finished, ended; (अम्), n. an embrace.
—परिवृत्तार्ध-मुख (˚त-अर्˚), अस्, ई, अम्,
having the face half turned round.
परि-वृति, इस्, f. surrounding, standing round.

परि-वृत्ति, इस्, f. revolution, return; exchange,
barter; end, termination; surrounding, encompassing;
staying in a place, dwelling; contraction of the pre-
puce, phimosis; (त्या), ind. alternately; (sometimes
परि-वृत्ति is a wrong reading for परि-वित्ति, q. v.)

परिवृंह् परि-वृंह् or परि-वृह्, also written
परि-बृंह् or परि-बृह्, q. v., p. 545, col. 1.
परि-वृंहण. See परि-बृंहण, p. 545.

परि-वृंहित or परि-वृहित. See परि-बृं-
हित, p. 545, col. 1.

परि-वृढ, अस्, m. a master, owner, &c. See
परि-बृढ, p. 545, col. 2.
परि-व्रढिमन्, आ, m. mastery, superiority.

परिव्रढिमन् परि-व्रढिमन्. See under
परि-वृंह्, p. 548, col. 2.

परिवृज् 1. परि-वृज्, cl. 7. 1. P. -वृणक्ति,
-वर्जति, -वर्जितुम्, to leave, forsake, abandon,
shun, avoid, quit, cease, leave off: Caus. -वर्जयति,
-यितुम्, to avoid, shun.

2. परि-वृज्, क्, f., Ved. avoiding, removing, (Sāy.
= परितः स्व-स्थान-त्याग); purification, expi-
ation.

परि-वर्ग, अस्, m., Ved. shunning, avoiding,
removing, discomfiting; अ-परिवर्गम्, ind. without
omission, without intermission, completely.
परि-वर्ग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be avoided.

परि-वर्जक, अस्, आ, अम्, shunning, avoiding;
giving up, resigning, abstaining from.

परि-वर्जन, अम्, n. avoiding, shunning, giving
up, resigning, quitting; abstaining from; killing,
slaughter.

परि-वर्जनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, avoidable, to be
avoided.

परि-वर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned, shunned;
deprived or devoid of.

परि-वृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. avoided, disliked,
[]
despised; (आ and ई), f. ‘the disliked or despised one,’
epithet of a wife lightly esteemed in comparison
with the favourite wife (महिषी, वावाता).

परिवृत् परि-वृत्, cl. 1. A. (also P. in Fut.,
Cond., and Aor.), to turn round, roll or wheel
round, revolve; to be whirled; to hasten to and
fro, roam or wander about; to change (e. g. क्ष-
णेन तत् परिवर्तते ऽन्यथा, that changes or turns
out to be different in a moment); to interchange;
to become, to be: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to
exchange.

परि-वर्तनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be exchanged,
capable of being exchanged.

परि-वर्तिका, f. contraction of the prepuce, phi-
mosis.

परि-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, moving round, going
round, revolving; circling, going in a circle, being
constantly renewed, ever recurring; changing, passing
into; being or remaining or staying in a place or
near a person (e. g. सुग्रीव-परिवर्तिन्, being
about, i. e. in attendance on Su-grīva); flying, re-
treating; exchanging, requiting, recompensing; (इनी),
f., scil. विष्टुति, a hymn arranged according to the
recurring form abc, abc, abc.

परि-वर्त्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. going or extending
round.

परि-वृत्य, ind. having turned round, having
revolved; having retreated or retired.

परिवृध् परि-वृध् [cf. परि-वृंह्], cl. 1.
A. (also P. in Fut., Cond., and Aor.) -वर्धते,
-वर्धितुम्, to grow, grow up, increase: Caus.
-वर्धयति, -यितुम्, to increase, augment; to
bring up, rear.

परि-वर्धन, अम्, n. increasing, augmenting,
enlarging, multiplying; growing; rearing, breeding
(as of cattle).

परि-वृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, grown, increased.
—परिवृद्ध-ता, f. increase, extension.
परि-वृद्धि, इस्, f. growth, increase.

परिवृस्ति परि-वृस्ति, इस्, m. a wrong reading
for परि-वित्ति, q. v.

परि-वेदित, अस्, आ, अम् (probably for परि-देवित),
lamented; (अम्), n. lamentation.

परिवेष्ट् परि-वेष्ट्, cl. 1. A. -वेष्टते,
-वेष्टितुम्, to surround, encompass, encircle; to
wrap up, cover, clothe: Caus. -वेष्टयति, -यितुम्,
to surround; to wrap up, clothe; to embrace.

परि-वेष्टन, अम्, n. surrounding, encompassing;
circumference; a cover, covering; a ligature, bandage.

परि-वेष्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, encompassed,
enclosed; beset, beleaguered; bound round, covered,
veiled, swathed.

परि-वेष्टितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who sur-
rounds or encompasses.

परिव्यक्त परि-व्यक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, very clear
or distinct; (अम्), ind. very clearly or distinctly.

परिव्यध् परि-व्यध्, cl. 4. P. -विध्यति,
-व्यद्धुम्, to hit, strike, smite, wound.

परि-व्याध, अस्, m. a species of reed, Calamus
Fasciculatus; a species of tree, Pterospermum Aceri-
folium; N. of an ancient sage.

परिव्यय परि-व्यय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 5. इ with
परि-वि), expense, cost; condiment, spices.

परिव्ये परि-व्ये, cl. 1. P. A. -व्ययति, -ते,
-व्यातुम्, to surround, invest, wrap round, veil, cover,
put on, wrap one's self up.

परि-वीत, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, encompassed,
invested; overspread, pervaded; (अम्), n. the bow
of Brahmā.
परि-वीय, ind. wrapping round.

परि-व्ययण, अम्, n., Ved. winding round,
covering.

परि-व्ययणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. relating to
wrapping round or binding on (as a verse).

परिव्रज् परि-व्रज्, cl. 1. P. -व्रजति, -व्र-
जितुम्, to go or wander about, wander about as a
mendicant, lead the life of a religious mendicant.

परि-व्राज्, ट्, or परि-व्राज, अस्, m. a vagrant,
wandering man, ascetic of the fourth and last religious
order, a mendicant devotee.

परि-व्रज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be roamed about or
walked for pleasure; (आ), f. strolling, wandering
about from place to place; religious wandering,
leading the life of a religious mendicant; ascetic
devotion, religious austerity, abandonment of the
world.
परि-व्राज्य, अम्, n. religious mendicancy.

पारिव्राज्य, अम्, n. (fr. परि-व्राज्), the wandering
life of a religious mendicant; (also incorrectly written
पारिव्रज्य.)

परि-व्राजक, अस्, इका, m. f. a wandering religious
mendicant.

पारिव्राजक पारिव्राजक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. परि-
व्राजक), intended for a religious mendicant; (अम्),
n. the wandering life of a religious mendicant.

परि-व्राजि, इस्, f. a species of plant, Sphæranthus
Mollis; [cf. तपो-धना, भिक्षु.]

परिशङ्क् परि-शङ्क्, cl. 1. A. -शङ्कते, -शङ्-
कितुम्, to suspect of (with inst.); to distrust.

परि-शङ्कनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be doubted or
distrusted; to be feared or apprehended; परिशङ्क-
नीयम्, (used impersonally) distrust must be felt.

परि-शङ्किन्, ई, इनी, इ, fearing, apprehending,
having apprehensions.

परिशप् परि-शप्, cl. 1. 4. P. A. -शपति,
-ते, -शप्यति, -ते, -शप्तुम्, to curse, execrate.
परि-शाप, अस्, m. cursing, reviling, anathema.

परिशम् परि-शम्, Caus. P. -शमयति, -यि-
तुम्, to allay, quench; to destroy.

परि-शमित, अस्, आ, अम्, allayed, quenched; de-
stroyed.

परिशाश्वत परि-शाश्वत, अस्, ई, अम्, remain-
ing or continuing for ever, perpetually the same.

परिशिष् परि-शिष्, Caus. P. -शेषयति, -यि-
तुम्, to leave over, leave (as a remainder); to leave
(a place), quit; with न, to destroy (e. g. मेघ-
नादस्य धनुर् न पर्य्-अशेषयत्, he did not
suffer to remain, i. e. he destroyed the bow of
Megha-nāda).

परि-शिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, left, remaining; finished;
(अम्), n. a supplement, appendix.
—परिशिष्ट-प्र-
काश, अस्, m., N. of a work by Śrī-nātha-śarman.

परि-शेष, अस्, आ, अम्, left over, remaining
(Ved.); (अस्, अम्), m. n. remnant, remains, re-
mainder, residue, rest; sequel, supplement; conclu-
sion, completion, termination; (एण), ind. with
the residue or conclusion; to the very end, com-
pletely, in full.
—परिशेष-शास्त्र, अम्, n. a sup-
plementary work, an appendix.
परीशेष परी-शेष = परि-शेष, q. v.
परि-शेषण, अम्, n. remainder, residue.

परिशीलन परि-शीलन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. शील्
with परि), frequent touch or contact, intercourse,
correspondence, constant occupation, fond pursuit of
or attachment to (a subject), study.

परिशुच् परि-शुच्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.)
-शोचति (-ते), -शोचितुम्, to be deeply grieved, mourn,
lament, bewail.

परिशुध् परि-शुध्, Caus. P. -शोधयति,
-यितुम्, to clear, clean, purify completely; to solve,
explain, clear up.

परि-शुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, completely cleansed,
cleaned, purified; acquitted, discharged; cleared off,
paid.
—परिशुद्ध-भाव, अस्, m. cleansed; dis-
charged, paid.

परि-शुद्धि, इस्, f. complete purification, becom-
ing perfectly clean; justification, acquittal, proving
innocent.

परि-शोध, अस्, m. cleansing, purifying, correct-
ing; discharging a debt or obligation, quittance.

परि-शोधन, अम्, n. purification; justification;
paying, discharging a debt.

परिशुश्रूषा परि-शुश्रूषा. See under प-
रि-श्रु, col. 3.
परि-शुश्रूषा, f. complete or implicit obedience.

परिशुष् परि-शुष्, cl. 4. P. (ep. also A.)
-शुष्यति (-ते), -शोष्टुम्, to be thoroughly dried up,
become quite dry; to shrivel, wither; to pine, waste
away; to be afflicted: Caus. -शोषयति, -यितुम्,
to emaciate.

परि-शुष्क, अस्, आ, अम्, perfectly dried up,
thoroughly dried, completely dry or parched;
withered, shriveled, shrunk (as a vein); hollow (as
the cheeks); परिशुष्कम् मांसम्, meat fried in
ghee, washed and spiced.
—परिशुष्क-तालु, उस्,
उस्, उ, having the palate dried up.
—परिशुष्क-
पलाश, अस्, आ, अम्, having withered foliage.
परि-शुष्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, drying up, evaporating.

परि-शोष, अस्, m. becoming completely dried
up, dryness, desiccation, evaporation.

परि-शोषण, अस्, आ, अम्, drying up, parching;
(अम्), n. drying, parching, emaciating.

परि-शोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, drying up, shriveling up,
becoming quite emaciated.

परिशून्य परि-शून्य, अस्, आ, अम्, quite empty,
quite free from, totally devoid of.

परिशृत 1. परि-शृत, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
ardent spirits; [cf. परि-स्रुत्, परि-स्रुता.]

परिशॄ परि-शॄ, Pass. -शीर्यते, to be cleft
or rent asunder, to be split.

परिसृ परि-सृ, cl. 1. P. -सरति, -सर्तुम्,
to go or flow round.

परिश्रम परि-श्रम, अस्, m. (fr. rt. श्रम्
with परि), fatigue, distress; fatiguing occupation,
labour, exertion, trouble, pain.
—परिश्रमापह
(˚म-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, relieving weariness.

परि-श्राम, अस्, m. fatigue, a fatiguing occu-
pation, exertion, toiling after.

परि-श्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thoroughly fatigued,
worn out, exhausted, wearied; one who has per-
formed acts of religious austerity.

परि-श्रान्ति, इस्, f. fatigue, exhaustion; labour,
trouble.

परि-श्रयण, अम्, n. encompassing, surrounding
with a fence.

परि-श्रित्, त्, f., Ved. ‘enclosure,’ epithet of certain
small stones laid round the hearth and other parts of
the altar.
2. परि-श्रित, अम्, n., Ved. = परि-वृतम्, q. v.

परिश्रु परि-श्रु, cl. 5. P. -शृणोति, -श्रोतुम्,
to hear.

परिस्रु परि-स्रु, cl. 1. P. -स्रवति, -स्रोतुम्,
to flow round, flow, stream, trickle; to ask (?).

परि-श्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, heard; (अस्), m., N. of
one of the attendants of Skanda.

परि-स्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, flowed, streamed round;
trickled, oozed; (आ), f. a kind of intoxicating liquor.

परिश्लिष्ट परि-श्लिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt.
श्लिष् with परि), embraced, clasped.
परि-श्लेष, अस्, m. embracing, an embrace.

परिषण्ड परि-षण्ड, a particular part of
a house.
—परिषण्ड-वारिक, a servant.

परिषद् 1. परि-षद् (परि-सद्), cl. 1. 6. P.
-षीदति, -षत्तुम्, Ved. to sit round.

2. परि-षद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. surrounding, besetting;
(त्), f. an assembly, meeting, audience, congregation,
council.
—परिषत्-त्व, अम्, n. the state of con-
stituting a legal assembly; a legal assemblage of
councillors.
—परिषद्-वल, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded
by a council; convoking assemblies; (अस्), m. a mem-
ber of an assembly, assessor, associate, spectator.

पारिषद् पारिषद्, त्, त्, त् (fr. परि-षद्),
one who is present at an assembly (?).

परि-षद, अस्, m. (a various reading for पारि-
षद), one of an assembly or congregation, a
councillor, assessor, a spectator at a play.

पारिषद, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to an assembly
or council, one who belongs to an assembly or council;
(अस्), m. a person present at an assembly or congre-
gation, a spectator; an assessor at a council; a king's
companion; (आस्), m. pl. the retinue or attendants of
a god; (अम्), n. taking part in an assembly; (अस्,
अम्), m. or n. (?), N. of a village in the North.

परि-षद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sought after
laboriously (Ved.); to be worshipped (Ved.); to be
avoided (Ved.); (according to Mahī-dhara) belonging
to an assembly; (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda
VII. 4, 7, = पर्य्-आप्त), sufficient, adequate, com-
petent; (अस्), m. a member of an assembly, assessor,
hearer, spectator, guest.

पारिषद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = परिषदं सम-
वैति, = परिषदि साधुः, one who is present at
an assembly, a spectator.

परि-षद्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. surrounding, en-
compassing, besetting.

परिषह् परि-षह् (परि-सह्), cl. 1. A.
-षहते, -षहितुम्, -षोढुम्, to sustain, bear
up against.

परिषिच् परि-षिच् (परि-सिच्), cl. 1. P. A.
-षिञ्चति, -ते, -षेक्तुम्, to sprinkle round, scatter
about, diffuse: Caus. -षेचयति (ep. -षिञ्चयति),
-यितुम्, to sprinkle round.

परि-षेक, अस्, m. sprinkling over, moistening;
a bath, bathing apparatus.
परीषेक परी-षेक = परि-षेक, q. v.
परि-षेचक, अस्, आ, अम्, pouring over, sprinkling.

परि-षेचन, अम्, n. pouring over, sprinkling;
water for watering tress.

परिषीवण परि-षीवण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. सिव्
with परि), Ved. sewing round, winding round.

परिषू परि-षू (परि-सू, see rt. 2. सू), cl.
6. P. -षुवति, -षवितुम्, Ved. to besiege, be-
leaguer.
परि-षूत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. besieged, beleaguered.

परि-षूति, इस्, f., Ved. oppression; (Sāy.) violence
(= परितः प्रेरक उपद्रवः).

परिषोडश परि-षोडश, अस्, ई, अम्, full six-
teen, quite sixteen.

परिष्कन्द् परि-ष्कन्द् or परि-स्कन्द्, cl. 1.
P. -ष्कन्दति, -ष्कन्तुम्, to leap about, spring
round or about.

परिस्कन्द् परि-स्कन्द्, परि-स्कन्द, परि-
स्कन्दत्, परि-स्कन्न. See परि-ष्कन्द्.

परि-ष्कण्ण or परि-ष्कन्न, अस्, m. a foster
[]
or adopted child, one nourished by a stranger; the
Koïl or Indian cuckoo (?).

परि-ष्कन्द or परि-स्कन्द, अस्, m. a foster
child, one nourished by a stranger; a servant; (औ),
m. du. two servants running by the two sides of a
carriage; (अम्), n. going round or about (?).

परिष्कृ परि-ष्-कृ (परि-कृ with स् inserted,
cf. परि-कृ, p. 538, col. 2), cl. 8. P. A. -करोति,
-कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, Ved. to prepare, fit out, equip;
to adorn, decorate; to polish, perfect; to cleanse.
परि-ष्-कर, अस्, m. ornament, decoration.

परि-ष्-कार, अस्, m. surrounding (?); adorning,
ornament, decoration, embellishment; finishing,
polishing; cooking, dressing; cleansing, purification
by essential rites, initiation; domestic utensils, furni-
ture.
—परिष्कार-चीवर, a kind of garment.

परि-ष्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, encom-
passed (?); prepared, equipped; adorned, decorated,
embellished; highly finished, polished; cooked,
dressed; cleansed, purified by initiatory rites.
—प-
रिष्कृत-भूमि, इस्, f. an altar or ground prepared
for a sacrifice or for the victim and sacrificial utensils.
परि-ष्-कृति, इस्, f. finishing, polishing; cleansing.

परि-ष्-क्रिया, f. adorning, decorating; (अग्नि-प्˚
is a various reading for अग्नि-परिक्रिया, q. v.)

परिष्टि परि-ष्टि, इस्, f. (according to some
fr. rt. 1. अस् with परि, but more probably fr. परि-
ष्ठा below; cf. अभि-ष्टि, उप-स्ति), Ved. obstruc-
tion, impediment; distress, dilemma; (Sāy.) searching
all round, (as if fr. rt. 3. इष् with परि.)

परीष्टि, इस्, f. investigation, research, inquiry,
(especially philosophical); service, attendance, rever-
ence, respect, homage, worship; willingness, readi-
ness, inclination.

परिष्टु परि-ष्टु (परि-स्तु), cl. 2. P. -स्तौति,
-स्तोतुम्, to praise, (Pāṇ. VIII. 3, 70.)

परि-ष्टवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. intended for
the Pari-ṣṭavana.
परि-ष्टुति, इस्, f. (fr. परि-स्तु), Ved. praise.

परि-ष्टोम, अस्, m. an elephant's coloured hous-
ings; a coverlet; a cushion; [cf. परि-स्तोम.]

परिष्टुभ् परि-ष्टुभ्, प्, प्, प् (fr. rt. स्तुभ्
with परि), Ved. uttering joyful cries or exulting on
every side; (Sāy.) = स्तुतिभिर् युक्त, endowed or
glorified with praises; (प्), f. exultation, acclamation.

परि-ष्टोभ, अस्, m., Ved. embellishing a Sāman
with the so-called Stobhas.

परिष्ठल परि-ष्ठल, अम्, n. surrounding
place or site.

परिष्ठा परि-ष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. ob-
structing, hindering, an obstructor; (आस्), f. obstruc-
tion, impediment.

परिष्यन्द परि-ष्यन्द or परि-स्यन्द, अस्,
m. (fr. rt. स्यन्द् with परि), a stream, river; wet-
ness, moisture; a sand-bank, island (Ved.).

परिस्यन्द परि-स्यन्द, अस्, m. (also परि-
ष्यन्द, q. v.), flow, stream, river; oozing, drop-
ping; train, retinue; decoration of the hair (=
परि-स्पन्द).

परि-ष्यन्दिन् or परि-स्यन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, flow-
ing, streaming.

परिष्वञ्ज् परि-ष्वञ्ज् (परि-स्वञ्ज्), cl. 1.
A. -ष्वजते (rarely P. -ष्वजति), -ष्वङ्क्तुम्, to
embrace.
परि-ष्वक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, embraced.

परि-ष्वङ्ग, अस्, m. embracing, an embrace;
contact, touch.
परि-ष्वजन, अम्, n. embracing, an embrace.

परि-ष्वजान, अस्, आ, अम्, embracing, (Rāmā-
yaṇa II. 83, 10.)
1. परि-ष्वज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be embraced.
2. परि-ष्वज्य, ind. having embraced.
परि-ष्वञ्जन, अम्, n. embracing, an embrace.

परि-ष्वञ्जल्य, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), Ved. a
particular domestic utensil.

परि-ष्वञ्जीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, Ved. clasping more
firmly.

परिष्वष्कित परि-ष्वष्कित, अम्, n. (fr. rt.
ष्वष्क् with परि, probably) the act of leaping
about.

परिसंलिह् परि-सं-लिह्, cl. 2. P. A. -लेढि,
-लीढे, -लेढुम्, to lick all round, lick over, lick.

परिसंवत्सर परि-संवत्सर, अस्, m. a
whole or full year; (आत्), ind. after the expiration
of a whole year; (अस्, आ, अम्), a whole year old; one
who has waited a whole year; (in medicine) chronic.

परिसंस्तु परि-सं-स्तु, cl. 2. P. A. -स्तौति,
-स्तवीति, -स्तुते, -स्तुवीते, -स्तोतुम्, to praise.
परि-संस्तूयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being praised.

परिसंस्थित परि-सं-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr.
rt. स्था with परि-सम्), standing together on every
side.

परिसंस्पृश् परि-सं-स्पृश्, cl. 6. P. -स्पृ-
शति, -स्प्रष्टुम्, -स्पर्ष्टुम्, to touch, stroke.

परिसंहा परि-सं-हा, cl. 3. A. -जिहीते, -हा-
तुम्, Ved. to lay aside, abandon (Sāy. = परि-त्यज्).

परिसंहृष्ट परि-सं-हृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, very
glad, greatly rejoiced.

परिसख्य परि-सख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
being on friendly terms.

परिसङ्क्रीड् परि-सङ्-क्रीड्, cl. 1. P. -क्रीडति,
-क्रीडितुम्, to play about, jest, amuse one's self.

परि-सङ्क्रीडत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, playing about,
indulging in amusements.

परिसङ्क्षिप् परि-सङ्-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A.
-क्षिपति, -ते, -क्षेप्तुम्, to encompass, encircle.

परिसङ्ख्या 1. परि-सङ्-ख्या, cl. 2. P. -ख्या-
ति, -ख्यातुम्, to count over, count up, reckon up,
calculate, add together; to enumerate.

2. परि-सङ्ख्या, f. enumerating one by one,
computation; sum; total, a number; an exhaustive
enumeration, exclusive specification, limitation to
that which is enumerated or expressly mentioned;
recapitulation.

परि-सङ्ख्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, counted, reckoned
up; enumerated, specified exclusively.

परि-सङ्ख्यान, अम्, n. enumeration; total; a
number; exclusive specification; a correct judgment,
proper estimate.

परिसङ्घुष् परि-सङ्-घुष्, cl. 1. P. -घो-
षति, -घोषितुम्, to make to resound on all sides,
to fill with cries.
परि-सङ्घुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, resonant on all sides.

परिसञ्चक्ष् परि-सञ्-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे,
-चष्टुम्, to enumerate; to avoid.

परि-सञ्चक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be avoided,
avoidable.

परिसञ्चर परि-सञ्चर, अस्, m. ‘a very diffi-
cult pass or defile,’ a critical period.

परिसञ्चि परि-सञ्-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति,
-चिनुते, -चेतुम्, to collect, accumulate.
परि-सञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, collected, accumulated.

परिसन्तप् परि-सन्-तप्, cl. 1. P. -तपति,
-तप्तुम्, to be tormented or afflicted; to scorch,
singe.
परि-सन्तप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, scorched, singed.

परि-सन्तप्य, ind. having been tormented;
having scorched.

परिसन्तान परि-सन्तान, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 3.
तन् with परि-सम्), Ved. a string, cord.

परिसभ्य परि-सभ्य, अस्, m. (fr. सभा with
परि), a member of an assembly, an assessor.

परिसमन्त परि-समन्त, अस् or अम्, m. or
n. (?), circumference, circuit.

परिसमाप् परि-सम्-आप्, Pass. -आप्यते, to
be fully completed, arrive at completion.

परि-समापन, अम्, n. the act of finishing
completely.

परि-समाप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fully completed, en-
tirely done or finished.

परि-समाप्ति, इस्, f. entire completion, end, con-
clusion.

परिसमुत्सुक परि-समुत्सुक, अस्, आ, अम्, very
anxious, greatly agitated or excited.

परिसमूह् परि-सम्-ऊह्, cl. 1. P. A. -ऊहति,
-ते, -ऊहितुम्, Ved. to heap or sweep together.

परि-समूहन, अम्, n. heaping up or sweeping
together.

परिसम्भू परि-सम्-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति,
-भवितुम्, Ved. to arise, spring, be produced.
परिसर परि-सर. See परि-सृ below.

परि-सर, अस्, m. standing-place, position, site;
verge, border, proximity, neighbourhood, environs,
ground on the border of a river or mountain or
contiguous to a town, &c.; width, breadth; death,
dying; rule, precept, prescribed mode; a god.

परि-सार, अस्, m. going round or about, wan-
dering about, perambulation.

परीसार परी-सार, अस्, m. = परि-सार, q. v.;
near approach (?).
परिसर्प परि-सर्प. See परि-सृप् below.

परि-सर्प, अस्, m. going or walking about,
perambulation; going about in search of anything,
following, pursuing, going after; surrounding, en-
circling; a species of serpent; a species of worm
causing leprosy; N. of a mild form of leprosy.

परिसहस्र परि-सहस्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. a
full thousand, at least a thousand.

परिसाध् परि-साध्, Caus. P. -साधयति,
-यितुम्, to finish, complete, settle (a cause).

परि-साधन, अम्, n. accomplishing, effecting,
finishing, bringing to a conclusion; arranging, set-
tling; determining, ascertaining.

परिसान्त्वन परि-सान्त्वन, अम्, n. the act
of consoling; conciliation.

परिसामन् परि-सामन्, अ, n., Ved. a Sāman
which is occasionally inserted.

परिसिध् परि-सिध्, cl. 1. P. -सेधति, -से-
धितुम्, to go round, go about.
परि-सिद्धिका, f. a kind of rice-gruel.

परि-सेधत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going round, going
about.

परिसीमन् परि-सीमन्, आ, m. a boundary,
border, extreme term or limit.

परिसीर्य परि-सीर्य, अम्, n. (fr. परि + सीर),
Ved. a leather thong on a plough.

परि-सरण, अम्, n. running or moving about.
—परिसरण-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, of a restless dispo-
sition, constantly, moving about.

परि-सर्या, f. running about, wandering or going
about, perambulation, circumambulation; near ap-
proach; service.

परि-सारक, अम्, n., N. of a place near the
Sarasvatī.

पारिसारक पारिसारक, अस्, ई, अम्, containing
the word परि-सारक.
परि-सारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wandering or running about.

परिसृप् परि-सृप्, cl. 1. P. -सर्पति, -सर्प्-
तुम्, -स्रप्तुम्, to go round, go to and fro.

परि-सर्पण, अम्, n. creeping about, walking
about, running to and fro, constantly changing one's
place; a kind of disease (= वि-सर्प).

परि-सर्पिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going or moving or roam-
ing about.

परिस्तृ परि-स्तृ, cl. 5. P. A. -स्तृणोति,
-णुते, or परि-स्तॄ, cl. 9. P. A. -स्तृणाति, -णीते,

पारिवेत्त्र्य, अम्, n. (fr. परि-वेत्तृ), the marry-
ing of a younger brother before the elder; the being
unmarried while a younger brother is married.

पारिश पारिश, अस्, m. a species of tree
(= फलीश, commonly called पलाश-पिपुल and
गज-हण्ड).
पारिशील पारिशील, अस्, m. a cake (= अपूप).

पारिशेष्य पारिशेष्य, अम्, n. (fr. परि-
शेष), that which is left over, a remainder; (आत्), ind.
this alone remaining, there being no alternative.

पारिषत्क, अस्, आ, अम्, one who studies or knows
what has been settled in an assembly (?).
पारिषदक, अस्, ई, अम्, done by an assembly.

पारिहारिक पारिहारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. परि-
हार), taking away, seizing; surrounding; (अस्), m.
a maker of garlands; (ई), f. a kind of riddle.
परि-खण्डन, अम्, n. annihilating, humiliating.

परि-ज्वल्, cl. 1. P. -ज्वलति, &c., to shine very
brightly, glow.
परिमण्डल-ता, whirling about or round.
परिलोलित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken about, tossed about.

परि-शान्त्व्, cl. 10. P. A. -शान्त्वयति, -ते, &c.,
to console, comfort, soothe, conciliate.
परि-षिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, sprinkled about, diffused.
